paragraphs.text: Townsfolk is an acorn class for Humans with no specific occupation. It was previously used on eternal-legal cards before being removed in the Grand Creature Type Update .

Townsfolk was introduced in Fallen Empires . Most Townsfolk have since had their class changed to something more appropriate (for instance, Anarchist was once a Townsfolk but is now a Wizard ), or are now simply humans without a class (such as Treasure Hunter ). Mark Rosewater later considered its removal a mistake.
The only cards with the creature type still are from Unglued .
Citizen , Peasant and Serf are similar in theme.
